findings.title: A shared route connects 17 wallets
findings.summary: The PAD log connects 17 of 23 wallets through one intermediate funding route. The other six reach the pad without that path. The scope supports a funding relationship; it does not name the person behind it.
findings.verifierNote: Shared infrastructure remains plausible. Keep the cluster provisional.

findings.title: The pull comes before the sell wave
findings.summary: The DRAIN timeline places two liquidity pulls ahead of the wider selling window. Reverse ordering would suggest a reactive exit; this ordering leaves pre-positioning as a question worth testing.
findings.verifierNote: Sequence accepted within the flight log. Intent requires independent evidence.

findings.title: Inside knowledge is not the only explanation
findings.summary: The earliest entries fit both a coordinated launch and an automated arbitrage response. A narrow window makes the activity unusual, but a public signal explains it without private information.
findings.verifierNote: The flight is cleared. Keep the private-link question on file.

findings.title: The swap pattern repeats an instruction path
findings.summary: The MIRROR ledger holds repeated route fingerprints with a matching retry boundary. That is consistent with a loop in the execution path. It does not establish deliberate volume inflation.
findings.verifierNote: Replace the manipulation claim with the narrower instruction-pattern observation.

findings.title: Three branches leave the intermediate account
findings.summary: The HANGAR scope splits into three paths after the intermediate account. Two return to known wallets. The third has no supported owner link and stays outside the attributed cluster.
findings.verifierNote: The unknown branch stays visible. Do not fold it into the known cluster.

findings.title: Authority history is the next decisive record
findings.summary: The MISSED APPROACH flight needs the sequence of authority changes and automation triggers. Price movement alone cannot tell an intentional exit from a failed execution policy.
findings.verifierNote: Evidence request approved. Keep motive open until the authority sequence arrives.

findings.title: The funding window is wider than the request window
findings.summary: The eight-second window is the headline. The earlier funding interval is the stronger lead, because it gives the tower a separate sequence to compare against.
findings.verifierNote: Keep request timing and funding timing as independent observations.

findings.title: Observation and intent need different verdicts
findings.summary: The two pull records support a statement about order. They do not support a statement about intent. The flight log now keeps those claims apart so later evidence can update each one.
findings.verifierNote: Attribution language narrowed. The sequence stays in the evidence strip.

findings.title: Three hypotheses survive the first plot
findings.summary: The scope keeps bot retry, route aggregation and deliberate repetition in play. Retry fits the instruction order best, while the other two need extra assumptions.
findings.verifierNote: A best fit is a working explanation, not a final attribution.

findings.title: Confidence rises once service overlap is counted
findings.summary: Treating a common service as common ownership artificially strengthens the cluster. The revised hypothesis counts service overlap and public timing as independent explanations.
findings.verifierNote: The tower will not turn infrastructure overlap into a claim about identity.

findings.title: An unresolved path becomes an evidence request
findings.summary: The third branch is now a dedicated request, not an assumed link. The tower can proceed on the two supported branches without overstating the unknown one.
findings.verifierNote: Scope accepted. The unresolved branch stays on the board.

findings.title: A flight can stay open without losing its shape
findings.summary: The record keeps the observed sequence, the explanations still in play, and the exact evidence needed next. An open verdict is useful when its boundaries are clear.
findings.verifierNote: Protocol accepted: evidence, explanation, challenge, next question.
